description: This interface defines methods for retrieving various dropdown options related to periods, conditions, days in month, and days in year within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: DropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for services that fetch dropdown options related to period frequency, condition types, days in month, and days in year.

methods.name: retrievePeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for the period frequency type dropdown.

methods.name: retrieveConditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for the condition type dropdown.

methods.name: retrieveDaysInMonthTypeOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for days in month dropdown.

methods.name: retrieveDaysInYearTypeOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for days in year dropdown.
